summary: Glossary export is hold with 2 critical, 12 high, and 1 warning finding(s).

findings.message: SNR has multiple approved expansions: signal-to-noise ratio; single nucleus rna.
findings.impact: Readers and downstream exports cannot know which definition applies in each section.
findings.remediation: Split the acronym by discipline or choose one canonical manuscript-level expansion.

findings.message: Glossary entry "SNR" would leak private reviewer or collaborator terminology notes.
findings.impact: Anonymous review notes, local paths, and private comments must not appear in manuscript exports.
findings.remediation: Redact private terminology notes and export only public glossary text.

findings.message: CRISPR first appears in section intro without its expansion.
findings.impact: Publication exports should define acronyms at first use for readers and reviewers.
findings.remediation: Introduce "Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)" at first use or move the first mention after the definition.

findings.message: SNR first appears in section methods without its expansion.
findings.impact: Publication exports should define acronyms at first use for readers and reviewers.
findings.remediation: Introduce "Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)" at first use or move the first mention after the definition.

findings.message: SNR first appears in section methods without its expansion.
findings.impact: Publication exports should define acronyms at first use for readers and reviewers.
findings.remediation: Introduce "Single nucleus RNA (SNR)" at first use or move the first mention after the definition.

findings.message: Unresolved terminology comment blocks export for batch effect.
findings.impact: The collaborative editor should not publish terminology while blocking review threads are open.
findings.remediation: Resolve the terminology comment or mark it non-blocking before export.

findings.message: Exportable glossary entry "SNR" is missing from the export glossary manifest.
findings.impact: Readers will see terminology in the manuscript without a matching glossary definition.
findings.remediation: Add the entry id to export.includeGlossaryIds or mark it as internal-only.

findings.message: Exportable glossary entry "batch effect" is missing from the export glossary manifest.
findings.impact: Readers will see terminology in the manuscript without a matching glossary definition.
findings.remediation: Add the entry id to export.includeGlossaryIds or mark it as internal-only.

findings.message: Terminology edit edit-locked-snr targets locked section methods without current approval.
findings.impact: Locked final-review sections should not accept glossary changes without explicit approval.
findings.remediation: Obtain approval for SNR against section version methods-v8.

findings.message: "SNR" appears in section methods but is absent from the exported glossary.
findings.impact: Collaborators can accidentally remove a needed term from the reader-facing glossary.
findings.remediation: Include the mentioned term in the export glossary or remove the stale manuscript mention.

findings.message: "batch effect" appears in section intro but is absent from the exported glossary.
findings.impact: Collaborators can accidentally remove a needed term from the reader-facing glossary.
findings.remediation: Include the mentioned term in the export glossary or remove the stale manuscript mention.

findings.message: Glossary entry "SNR" has an incomplete definition.
findings.impact: Short or missing definitions create discipline-specific ambiguity during review.
findings.remediation: Add a concise, reviewer-ready definition with enough scientific context.

findings.message: Glossary entry "batch effect" has an incomplete definition.
findings.impact: Short or missing definitions create discipline-specific ambiguity during review.
findings.remediation: Add a concise, reviewer-ready definition with enough scientific context.

findings.message: Glossary entry "SNR" is exportable but not approved.
findings.impact: Collaborative manuscripts should not export provisional terminology.
findings.remediation: Route the term through collaborator approval or hold it from export.

findings.message: Glossary entry "CRISPR" was approved against an older version of section intro.
findings.impact: Collaborative edits may have changed the term context since approval.
findings.remediation: Refresh the term anchor against the current section version.
